notes.title: 2025: Development Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42872934/6dcf390a3063a81cf9aaec41cfaf844a588d9b30.png[/img]

Today, Your Turn to Die Steam Edition will celebrate its 2nd anniversary!

Due to the nature of the game, we have been unable to share many development updates to avoid spoilers, and we sincerely apologize for that. Some of you may have been worried, wondering, "Will the game ever be completed?"

Rest assured, developer Nankidai-sensei is working tirelessly to bring you the best possible experience. The final chapter is shaping up to be something that will surpass your expectations—an experience that will make you say, "I'm so glad I played Your Turn to Die!" We hope you are as excited as we are, and we appreciate your patience as we put the finishing touches on it.

This year, we look forward to delivering the news you’ve all been waiting for!
